objective: arithmetic mean of official VUS-PR across all 48 tuning series; any failure fails the candidate
data_access: offline unsupervised full unlabelled series and official training prefix; no labels, file names, dataset identities or anomaly positions
normalization: no additional evaluator normalization; candidate chooses preprocessing as in official runner
metric_implementation: unchanged basic_metricor.metric_PR/metric_ROC and generate_curve, the exact four primary calculations inside official get_metrics
secondary_f1: optional --all-metrics frozen final evaluation only; official get_metrics default oracle thresholds; descriptive only, not deployable threshold selection; undefined secondary values are null

execution_profiles.linux: CUDA; existing host profiles and sandbox
execution_profiles.macos: MPS with explicit CPU fallback for unsupported operations; single evaluation slot; identical time and host-memory limits; see host profile
